package consumer

import (
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/db"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/examples/article/models"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
)

var _ orm.ModelDescriptor[models.Article] = models.ArticleDescriptor{}

func BuildArticleQuery(backend db.Queryer) (orm.QuerySet[models.Article], error) {
	querySet := models.ArticleObjects.Using(backend).
		Filter(
			models.ArticleFields.Published.Exact(true),
			models.ArticleFields.Title.IContains("django"),
			models.ArticleFields.Summary.IsNull(false),
		).
		OrderBy(models.ArticleFields.ID.Desc())
	return querySet.Limit(2)
}
